verdict.rationale: Missive documents a public REST API at public.missiveapp.com/v1. It has a complete endpoint reference covering conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels and analytics, with example requests, documented rate limits and 429 handling, and Markdown docs plus an llms.txt index suited to AI agents. An official MCP server is also documented. Probes confirm there is no OpenAPI spec, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration that the API works as described. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec, formal versioning/deprecation policy, independent hands-on corroboration.
